behaviors_asserted: For identical response bodies, the ETag should remain stable across requests, regardless of how the body is chunked.
When combining the etag() and cache() middleware on Cloudflare Workers, the ETag value changes on every request even when the response body remains the same.
On Cloudflare Workers, responses returned from the cache expose .body as a ReadableStream whose chunk structure is not consistent across requests.
PR #3832 introduced the generateDigest(body: Uint8Array) option.

values_specified.suggested_generate_etag_signature: generateETag?: (res: ClonedResponse or stream?) => string | Promise<string>
